description: Audit and segmentation of the four raw OCR books before NER.
notes: Observed text is preserved exactly; no OCR normalization is performed.
List of Records No. references inside document records remain in primary text because they are part of the document/editorial metadata on those pages.
Volume II begins directly with Court Book text.
Volumes III-IV front matter is stored with the introduction/editorial set-aside.
Editorial index pages are stored with the introduction/editorial set-aside for now.
Volume I primary pages are ordered chronologically across its two raw OCR blocks: source keys 437+ followed by source keys 51-266.
Primary pages have stable page_id, section_id, and source_id fields; original source_page_key and exact text are retained.

reocr.description: Primary text re-OCR'd with Tesseract 5 (--psm 1, hOCR) from the Internet Archive scans of the 1906-1935 Kingsbury edition (recordsofvirgini01virg ... 04virg), then split by word positions into running head, body, margin notes, and footnotes (src/ocr_layout.py). Page IDs are unchanged; each page was matched by printed page number and verified by word overlap (src/build_primary_text_from_reocr.py).
reocr.text_field: running head (first line) + body. Margin notes and footnotes are in their own fields; the previous OCR is kept in original_text.
reocr.duplicates: The original scans repeated some Volume II pages; the second copies are emptied (ocr_source=duplicate, duplicate_of=<page_id>): V02-P0051, V02-P0137, V02-P0138, V02-P0139, V02-P0140, V02-P0143, V02-P0144, V02-P0145, V02-P0146, V02-P0151, V02-P0152.
reocr.kept_original: Mostly facsimile plates of handwriting (OCR is noise either way), plus seven Volume III shareholder-list pages with dotted leaders and one Volume IV letter where no re-OCR page verified.
